subject: Implementation surcharge & packaging: SignalPath migration
messages:
From: Tom Sanders <t.sanders@signalpath.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@signalpath.ai>, Eric Lowe <eric.lowe@signalpath.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation surcharge & packaging: SignalPath migration

Connor —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We had a follow-up internal discussion about economics and the implementation support CloudForge quoted us. They included a $200k migration credit and 3 months of premium support in their package; that plus a reduced onboarding fee is what’s keeping them competitive on the table.

Before we escalate procurement, can you share Redwood’s standard implementation surcharge, typical onboarding credit ranges, and whether you have an equivalent credit/waiver play for migrations? Also, we need a clear line-itemed comparison of one-time fees vs first-year TCO so we can present to finance.

Attached is the competitor rate sheet they sent (CloudForge_Rate_Sheet.pdf). If Redwood can provide a matched economic outcome or an alternate structure that reduces risk for us during the transition, we can accelerate.

Key asks: 
- Migration credit (how much can you commit up front)
- Implementation/onboarding fee (waivers or included SRE hours)
- Net effective price over 12 months given discounts/credits
- Any limited-time price match or pilot credits you can offer

We’re aiming to decide by next Wednesday (8/4).

Tom
Tom Sanders
VP, Infrastructure
SignalPath

--- Attachment: CloudForge_Rate_Sheet.pdf (PDF) ---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Sanders <t.sanders@signalpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation surcharge & packaging: SignalPath migration

Tom —

Appreciate the context and the candid timeline. I’ve looped in Marissa (commercial) and Marcus (solutions) to provide an economic comparison and a deployment/playbook outline. We can do a short runbook-style TCO that shows net-first-year spend and inseparable support credits so you can compare apples-to-apples.

Can you confirm the CloudForge proposal is contingent on a 12-month commit and whether the $200k credit is applied as an upfront invoice credit or as a rebate tied to usage? That will affect how we structure the match.

Propose a 30-minute follow-up tomorrow at 10am PT to walk through options — I’ll send a calendar invite if that works.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0192

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Sanders <t.sanders@signalpath.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation surcharge & packaging: SignalPath migration

Tom / Connor —

Thanks — I reviewed CloudForge’s sheet and sketched three commercial constructs that typically close in situations like this. High-level options (net-first-year economics below are illustrative; I can produce a model if you want):

Option A — Migration Credit + Standard Package
- Implementation surcharge (standard): $25,000
- Onboarding credit (migration): up to $150,000 applied as invoice credit over first 3 months
- Net effective discount: ~18% first-year on list rates with a 12-month $120k ARR commit
- Includes 40 hours SRE during onboarding; additional SRE billed at $250/hr

Option B — Waive Implementation with Commitment
- Implementation surcharge waived if customer signs 12-month committed plan >= $120k ARR
- Offer a $100k migration credit + 3 months premium support (concierge)
- Tiered usage discount kicked in at month 7

Option C — Short-Term Pilot + Make-Good
- 3-month pilot at 50% list with $60k pilot credit applied to first invoice if converted to annual contract within 30 days of pilot end
- Migration assistance available as paid professional services or converted to credit under a conversion clause

Operational notes: 
- Migration credit vs cash rebate: we prefer invoice credit (reduces churn risk and simplifies legal)
- SLA: our standard SLA for Dedicated is 99.9% (enterprise add-on for 99.95%). We can include a 30-day SLA ramp for pilot projects.
- We can commit to a staffed migration playbook (runbook, weekly checkpoints, and a named SRE for the first 60 days) for the larger packages.

I’ve attached a working spreadsheet with line-item economics (commercial_options_signalpath_v2.xlsx) and a short pricing rationale. Connor — I left placeholders where we need the final expected ARR and typical QPS so I can fine-tune the net-first-year calculation.

Happy to hop on the call — available 10am PT tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
--- Attachments: commercial_options_signalpath_v2.xlsx, pricing_notes.md ---

From: Tom Sanders <t.sanders@signalpath.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@signalpath.ai>, Eric Lowe <eric.lowe@signalpath.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation surcharge & packaging: SignalPath migration

Marissa/Connor —

Thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifying points from procurement/finance: 

1) CloudForge is offering $200k as an upfront credit applied to the first invoice and 3 months of dedicated premium support. That’s materially reducing our first-year cash outlay.
2) The credit is conditioned on an annual commit (we’d be comfortable with a 12-month ARR commitment).

For us to move fast I need a single-line net-first-year comparison (list price, concessions, net effective ARR-equivalent) plus a signed commitment that the migration playbook and X hours of on-site/remote SRE will be provided. Can Redwood match the $200k credit or provide an alternate structure that pulls forward value in the first 90 days (credits, waived fees, extended support)?

If you cannot match $200k, what is the maximum migration credit you can commit to today, and can you confirm the playbook + 3 months concierge support will be included in any matching offer?

Appreciate the transparency — we want this to be a pragmatic decision.

Tom

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Sanders <t.sanders@signalpath.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation surcharge & packaging: SignalPath migration

Tom —

Quick technical operational note to complement Marissa’s commercial options: 

- We can provide a migration playbook with runbooks for data egress, model conversion, and KV cache warm-up. The core playbook is zero-cost and included for any enterprise customer.
- For high-touch onboarding we typically include 40 hours of SRE/Eng support (remote) as part of the migration credit package. Additional onsite or extended SRE is available at discounted block rates.
- We offer an option to pre-quantize and validate models on a staging fleet prior to cutover — that reduces go-live risk and can be scoped as part of the migration credit.

I’ve dropped a link to the shared technical runbook here: https://docs.redwood.ai/shared/signalpath-migration-playbook (has sample scripts and rollback steps). Happy to walk your engineers through the playbook; can do a 60-min workshop as part of the onboarding package.

If you need a firm SLA uplift to 99.95% for the contract, we’ll need to include the enterprise SLA addendum and a short ramp fee for the first 90 days to cover redundancy setup; we can fold that into the migration credit conversation.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Sanders <t.sanders@signalpath.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Final offer: migration credit + onboarding package (SignalPath)

Tom / Priya / Eric —

Thanks for the back-and-forth and for sharing the CloudForge terms. To move this to legal and close by your target, Redwood can make the following contingent offer: 

- Migration credit: $150,000 invoice credit applied across first two billing cycles
- Implementation surcharge: waived on signature when customer commits to a 12-month contract at a minimum of $10,000/month (annualized $120,000)
- Concierge support: 3 months premium support included (named CSM + escalation path)
- SRE hours: 40 hours included in the migration credit; additional hours at a discounted rate
- SLA: standard 99.9% included; can add 99.95% SLA via addendum with a short ramp fee (we will credit ramp fee back if migration benchmarks are met)
- Price-match clause: for the first 12 months we’ll match any materially equivalent written competitor credit under the same commit structure up to the offered credit amount (proof required)

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf (includes scope and milestones). Next steps: 
1) Please confirm acceptance of the headline concession above by EOD Mon 8/2 so we can route to legal for a short-form SOW.
2) If accepted, I’ll send a DocuSign for the SOW and the pricing addendum.

We believe this structure balances SignalPath’s near-term cash concerns with Redwood’s need for a committed relationship — it also gives us the runway to prove TCO improvements. If you need an alternate structure that prioritizes more upfront credit vs commitment length, we can model Option A vs Option B this afternoon.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
